item.title: Delays in Xero sync [resolved]
item.description:
We’ve experienced an issue that may have caused delays in the automatic syncing of transaction data to Xero for some members between 1-6 May.
We’ve fixed this
Your existing automatic connection might have been interrupted - all you need to do is reconnect your Tide account to Xero: App: Admin > All Actions > Accounting integrations Web: Tools & Services > Accounting integrations
If you need further assistance, please email hello@tide.co or use the 'Support' feature within your app.

item.title: Delays in Tide Accounting [resolved]
item.description:
This issue is now resolved.
If earlier you had issues with: Your subscription being activated - you should be able to access accounting features now Incorrect reports - please regenerate them and let us know if you need any further assistance Updates on categories/VAT reflected - these should be updating now as usual
Thank you for your patience while we were working on resolving this. If you still need assistance, please tap ‘Support’ in your app – we’ll be there to help.
